claims.claim: Initializes the turn counter inside the extension function and starts it at zero.
On session start, writes dim Ready text under the status-demo key.
On turn start, increments the counter and writes an accent dot with dim numbered in-progress text under the same key.
On turn end, writes a success check with dim completion text containing the current turn number.
On a session switch whose reason is new, resets the counter and restores dim Ready text; other switch reasons do not enter that branch.
